items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1960-09-16
items.q: I made some records with him playing the string bass with Wooden Joe Nicholas.

ctx.x: One was called Sport and what was the other one called? They had a...

Let's call him Boots. Boots, yeah. That's Albert Young. That's Boots. He's called him Boots for nickname. Yeah. That's like Jim Crow. Yeah. Jam Robinson. I made some records with him playing the string bass with Wooden Joe Nicholas. Boots. Boots, yeah. He's a good trombone player too. Yeah, that's all right. I remember he didn't. He lost his teeth. He wasn't playing anymore. I forget the teeth. He wasn't playing anymore but he played a while after he lost his teeth. Son Henry said he don't understand that fella.…
